Level-0 Make toot sound like a stupid baby
Level-1 customise toot to repeat what I say
Add in-memory task storage and listing
commitResults.messageBody: Store user-entered tasks in a fixed-size array and support numbered list output so tasks remain available throughout a chat session.

Store completion state alongside task descriptions so the mark command can update a selected task and list can render clear done indicators. Validate task numbers to keep malformed mark commands from crashing the chatbot.
Allow completed tasks to return to a not-done state through the unmark command. Validate task numbers and keep list markers consistent so users can safely reverse completion status.

Move task descriptions, completion state, status formatting, and state transitions into a dedicated Task class. Refactor the command loop to use Task objects so related data cannot become misaligned and future task behavior has a clear home.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level-4 typed tasks with inheritance
commitResults.messageBody: Represent todos, deadlines, and events as Task subclasses and parse their typed commands while preserving raw date/time text. Add exact console regression coverage and project guidance so later code updates rerun the UI plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid chatbot input with clear exceptions
commitResults.messageBody: Validate task commands and indices so malformed input returns specific guidance instead of crashing. Expand exact-output UI coverage for negative cases and state preservation.
Replace fixed task storage with ArrayList so tasks can be removed dynamically. Add validated delete command handling and exact-output regression coverage for removal and renumbering.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use enum to centralize command parsing
commitResults.messageBody: Represent the fixed command set as CommandType so dispatch and argument rules are compiler-checked while preserving the existing console behavior.

Version the project-specific present-changes-visually workflow and its split-view diff generator so every clone can produce consistent, reviewable HTML comparisons without relying on a user-level skill installation.
Save every task-list mutation and restore tasks at startup so user data survives between sessions. Handle missing folders and malformed data, and isolate UI tests from the user's data file.

Parse ISO deadline dates into LocalDate so invalid dates are rejected, display dates consistently for users, and preserve the ISO representation in storage. Update the exact-output UI plan to cover the new behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor Toot into focused domain packages
commitResults.messageBody: Extract UI, parsing, task-list, and persistence responsibilities so the application entry point only coordinates collaborators. Organize the resulting classes by responsibility to make ownership and future changes clearer while preserving the Level-8 console behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Gradle build and run support
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce the Gradle wrapper and application configuration for reproducible Java 25 builds. Update the documented and regression-test launch commands so Toot can be compiled and run through Gradle after its package reorganization.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add focused JUnit coverage for parsing and storage
commitResults.messageBody: Configure JUnit Jupiter in Gradle and test the highest-risk command parsing, task construction, persistence round trips, escaping, and corrupt-data handling. This protects core behavior independently of the console regression suite.

commitResults.messageTitle: Package Toot as an executable JAR
commitResults.messageBody: Configure the Shadow plugin to produce build/libs/Toot.jar with the correct main-class manifest. Document how to build, distribute, and run the self-contained artifact without committing generated binaries.
